load_camera_parameters_from_yaml: load camera calibration parameters from a YAML config file using CameraParameters.load
create_calibrated_camera: create a CalibratedCamera with camera matrix, distortion coefficients, and world-to-camera transform
create_trifinger_camera_array: create a TriFinger camera array from calibration config files using create_trifinger_camera_array_from_config
convert_calibration_data_to_matrix: convert calibration data dict with rows, cols, and data keys into a numpy matrix
simulate_trifinger_cameras: simulate the three TriFinger platform cameras using TriFingerCameras and capture RGB images
